# verifier/sigcat_spot_values.txt -- spot-check graphs of the three certificates of Theorem sigmacat (part (m) of
# verify_all.sh) and the exact value of slack - b at each, as computed by the independent review of these
# certificates with its pure-Python definitional evaluator (s7_pycheck.py). slack(H) = f(H) - sum_k c_{Q_k}(H), b = the
# certificate's bound. Per certificate, in this order: the six lowest distinct values of the review's raw scan (their
# smallest labelled masks; the first attains b), the producer's argmin graph (for K5_4minus it is the first graph and
# is not repeated), two random relabellings of the first graph, five random admissible graphs, and three support graphs
# of the extremal construction (J4: iterated Fano-plane complement; K5lt: C_n; K5_4minus: Sidorenko's doubling).
# Columns: certificate (directory under certificates/sigma_catalogue/), colex mask on [7], slack - b (exact).
# The values are used by the steps sigcat_pyvals_* (fast) and, through s7_cmp.py, sigcat_cmp_* (--raw sigcat_*).
